items.name: create-ticket
items.description: Turn an issue or feature description plus screenshots, files, logs and repository context into a structured local engineering ticket. Use for reporting bugs, requests and tasks; never implement during creation.

items.name: discover-team
items.description: Discover and reuse repository-specific Codex agents and skills before orchestrating a ticket; produce an inventory and suggest role mappings without overwriting configuration.

items.name: feature-build
items.description: Implement a selected RoadTrip feature plan, coordinate bounded specialists, verify integrated behavior, and record observed progress.

items.name: feature-map
items.description: Map a RoadTrip feature request through the implemented app flow, interfaces, lifecycle invariants, and relevant tests before planning or implementation.

items.name: feature-plan
items.description: Turn a RoadTrip feature request into a repository-grounded, decision-complete implementation plan saved under .codex/plans/.

items.name: process-ticket
items.description: Orchestrate an existing engineering ticket through reproduction, planning, specialist implementation, independent review, testing and QA; finish at human verification, never auto-merge.

items.name: project-init
items.description: Inspect RoadTrip and create or refresh concise, source-verified architecture and convention knowledge for future work.

items.name: verify-ticket
items.description: Record a human verifier's approval or rejection of a processed ticket, update status, and route rejected work back to implementation.

items.name: architecture
items.description: Read-only RoadTrip feature mapper for tracing UI, ride lifecycle, state, persistence, integrations, and contracts before substantial changes.

items.name: code_reviewer
items.description: Independent read-only reviewer for RoadTrip correctness, regressions, integration contracts, and missing tests.

items.name: frontend_engineer
items.description: Bounded Ionic React and TypeScript implementer for RoadTrip UI, hooks, and client-side behavior.

items.name: qa
items.description: Read-only QA specialist for RoadTrip acceptance criteria, lifecycle edge cases, test gaps, and integrated verification.

items.name: release_reviewer
items.description: Read-only release readiness reviewer for RoadTrip compatibility, native configuration, docs, and validation evidence.

items.name: security_reviewer
items.description: Read-only targeted security reviewer for RoadTrip client data handling, external integrations, and native boundaries.
